              console.log(`Author ${author} is in trusted contributors list`);
              return true;
            } else {
              console.log(`Author ${author} is not in trusted contributors list`);
              return false;

        id: check-fork
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}" != "${{ github.repository }}" ]]; then
            echo "is_fork=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "is_fork=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Check if PR is from fork and author is not trusted
        if: env.is_fork == 'true' && steps.check-author-permissions.outputs.result == 'false' && steps.check-trusted-contributors.outputs.result == 'false'

              owner: owner,
              repo: repo,
              pull_number: prNumber,
              state: 'closed'
            });

            throw new Error('PR closed due to security policy restrictions');

        if: env.is_fork == 'true' && (steps.check-author-permissions.outputs.result == 'true' || steps.check-trusted-contributors.outputs.result == 'true')
        run: |
          echo "PR from trusted contributor or member - allowing through"

      - name: Check if PR is from same repository
        if: env.is_fork == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "PR from same repository - allowing through"

      - name: Check for specific labels
        id: check-labels
        uses: actions/github-script@60a0d83039c9870b4ff93f6499e234549cd06c11 # v7.0.1

          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const labels = context.payload.pull_request.labels.map(label => label.name);
            
            // Check for required labels
            const requiredLabels = ['needs-review', 'ready-to-merge'];
            const hasRequiredLabel = requiredLabels.some(label => labels.includes(label));
            
            if (!hasRequiredLabel) {
              console.log('PR does not have required labels');
              return false;
            } else {
              console.log('PR has required labels');
              return true;
            }

      - name: Validate PR title format
        id: validate-title
        run: |
          PR_TITLE="${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}"
          # Check if title starts with valid prefix
          if [[ "$PR_TITLE" =~ ^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore|perf|ci|build|revert)\(.*\):.* ]]; then
            echo "PR title format is valid"
          else
            echo "PR title format is invalid"
            echo "PR title should follow conventional commit format: <type>(<scope>): <subject>"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate PR description
        id: validate-description
        run: |
          PR_DESCRIPTION="${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
          # Check if PR description is not empty
          if [[ -z "$PR_DESCRIPTION" ]]; then
            echo "PR description is empty"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "PR description is present"
          fi

      - name: Validate PR changes
        id: validate-changes
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        with:
          files: |
            airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/**
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md
            docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md
          separator: ","

      - name: Check if changes are in zendesk chat connector
        if: steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files_count == 0
        run: |
          echo "No changes detected in zendesk chat connector"
          exit 1

      - name: Validate manifest changes
        if: steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files_count > 0
        run: |
          # Check if manifest.yaml was modified
          if [[ "${{ steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files }}" == *"manifest.yaml"* ]]; then
            echo "Manifest file was modified"
          else
            echo "Manifest file was not modified"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate metadata changes
        if: steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files_count > 0
        run: |
          # Check if metadata.yaml was modified
          if [[ "${{ steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files }}" == *"metadata.yaml"* ]]; then
            echo "Metadata file was modified"
          else
            echo "Metadata file was not modified"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate documentation changes
        if: steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files_count > 0
        run: |
          # Check if documentation files were modified
          if [[ "${{ steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files }}" == *"zendesk-chat.md"* ]] || [[ "${{ steps.validate-changes.outputs.all_changed_files }}" == *"zendesk-chat-migrations.md"* ]]; then
            echo "Documentation files were modified"
          else
            echo "Documentation files were not modified"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate version bump
        run: |
          # Check if version was bumped in metadata.yaml
          VERSION_BUMPED=$(grep -c "version: 1.2.21" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/metadata.yaml)
          if [ "$VERSION_BUMPED" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Version was properly bumped to 1.2.21"
          else
            echo "Version was not bumped to 1.2.21"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate changelog entry
        run: |
          # Check if changelog entry was added to documentation
          CHANGELOG_ADDED=$(grep -c "Handle 404 errors for deleted records" docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat.md)
          if [ "$CHANGELOG_ADDED" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Changelog entry was added"
          else
            echo "Changelog entry was not added"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate header formatting
        run: |
          # Check if header formatting was fixed in migrations doc
          HEADER_FIXED=$(grep -c "# Zendesk Chat Migrations" docs/integrations/sources/zendesk-chat-migrations.md)
          if [ "$HEADER_FIXED" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Header formatting was fixed"
          else
            echo "Header formatting was not fixed"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate error handling configuration
        run: |
          # Check if 404 response filters were added to manifest
          FILTERS_ADDED=$(grep -c "status_code: 404" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
          if [ "$FILTERS_ADDED" -ge 2 ]; then
            echo "404 response filters were added to manifest"
          else
            echo "404 response filters were not added to manifest"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate ignore action
        run: |
          # Check if ignore action was configured for 404 errors
          IGNORE_ACTION=$(grep -A 3 -B 1 "action: IGNORE" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
          if [ -n "$IGNORE_ACTION" ]; then
            echo "Ignore action was configured for 404 errors"
          else
            echo "Ignore action was not configured for 404 errors"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate error message
        run: |
          # Check if descriptive error message was added
          ERROR_MESSAGE=$(grep -c "Record not found (likely deleted). Skipping." airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
          if [ "$ERROR_MESSAGE" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Descriptive error message was added"
          else
            echo "Descriptive error message was not added"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate streams affected
        run: |
          # Check if chats and agent_timeline streams were updated
          CHATS_STREAM=$(grep -c "chats" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
          AGENT_TIMELINE_STREAM=$(grep -c "agent_timeline" airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-zendesk-chat/manifest.yaml)
          if [ "$CHATS_STREAM" -gt 0 ] && [ "$AGENT_TIMELINE_STREAM" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Both chats and agent_timeline streams were updated"
          else
            echo "One or both streams were not updated"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Final validation
        run: |
          echo "All validations passed - PR meets community standards"
